Before we lock a date, our legal team has surfaced a procurement redline that may change the cadence on the pen test.

- Can you send 2x 60-min slots this week and 2x slots next week (US-friendly times)?
- Any pre-read (evidence index or control mapping) you can attach now would help legal triage.
- We may need to delay the pen test kickoff by ~2 weeks depending on contract notes — is that manageable?

Attached: ClearSight_SOC2_Questions.pdf (pdf) — high level questions legal would like addressed during the call.

Best,
Alan Roberts
